lead_fa: Augmentation یک اسپک حمایتی-تهاجمی یکتاست: با جادوی سیاه زمین به دشمن آسیب می‌زنی و همزمان متحدها را با [[Ebon Might]] و [[Prescience]] تقویت می‌کنی. دو مسیر Hero Tree داری: [[Chronowarden]] با پتانسیل آسیب بالاتر در سطح حرفه‌ای و [[Scalecommander]] با بازی ساده‌تر که برای بازیکن متوسط در Mythic+ نتیجه بهتری می‌دهد.

strengths: Highly accessible: gameplay and rotation are easy to pick up
Potent group damage by buffing your own damage and nearby allies
Excellent survivability: Defy Fate plus extra defensives and bonus armor against Physical damage
Exceptional mobility: high Hover uptime and Glide control while falling
Best-in-class utility: Rescue, Time Spiral, Spatial Paradox, Cauterizing Flame
weaknesses: 25-yard maximum range as a ranged caster
Direct damage is limited; output relies on ally effectiveness in group content
Effectiveness drops if a buff target dies, especially in dungeons
Limited AoE scaling; no meaningful priority burst or spread cleave beyond ally buffs

hero.recommendation: Both trees share a similar playstyle and damage potential. Chronowarden has the highest top-end damage and is preferred in raids; Scalecommander is more straightforward and less reliant on ally-buffed throughput, so average players may find more success with it in Mythic+.
hero.chronowarden: Bronze time-magic theme: Haste and cooldown reduction, improving the spec's major group buffs.
hero.scalecommander: Personal damage emphasis with a distinct focus on Breath of Eons.

builds.codes_source: Wowhead 'Best Augmentation Evoker Talent Builds' page (wowhead.com/guide/classes/evoker/augmentation/talent-builds-pve-dps), export strings captured verbatim via the page's Copy buttons on 2026-10-27; do not modify.

concepts: Weave key damaging and buffing abilities together; avoid spending resources outside Ebon Might whenever possible to maximize buff uptime on allies.
Only cast Fire Breath and Upheaval while Ebon Might is up: it extends Ebon Might and directs Shifting Sands toward buffed allies.
Maintain Prescience on allied DPS and Blistering Scales on a tank at all times.

st_chronowarden: Maintain Prescience on allied DPS players
Ebon Might if a few seconds or less remain on the active buff duration
Fire Breath at Rank 1 or Max Rank
Upheaval at Rank 1 unless increased radius is needed
Time Skip if talented (see cooldown usage)
Living Flame as filler in nearly all situations
Azure Strike as backup filler while moving or to slow enemies
Maintain Blistering Scales on a tank
rotation.aoe_note: The AoE priority mirrors single target; the AoE page keeps the same skeleton around Ebon Might windows with Eruption prioritized.
opener: Pre-cast Blistering Scales on a tank
Use trinket and Potion of Recklessness
Prescience on Buff Target 1 (position for Breath of Eons during this)
Breath of Eons with a short, safe flight path
Ebon Might immediately after combat starts (Midnight change: buff the raid ASAP)
Fire Breath at Max Rank via Tip the Scales
Upheaval at Rank 1 unless radius is needed
rotation.empower_notes: Fire Breath at higher Ranks increases upfront damage but reduces the DoT duration; Leaping Flames benefits from higher Ranks. Only cast empower spells inside Ebon Might windows.

gear.gearing_rules: Chronowarden and Scalecommander: Intellect >> Mastery > Critical Strike > Haste > Versatility. Intellect/ilvl upgrades still win. Sim with Raidbots. The tier set favors Chronowarden slightly.

tier_set.name: Echo of Calamity
tier_set.pc2: Upheaval's cooldown is reduced by 10 sec.
tier_set.pc4: Upheaval magnifies your Fate Mirror effects for 8 sec, increasing the amount of damage echoed to 45%.
tier_set.note: Does not impact the core rotation; slight bias toward Chronowarden in how the effects interact with hero toolkits.

catalyst: Cuisses of the Uncoiled Union (Coiled Altar)

stats.cheatsheet: Intellect >> Mastery > Crit > Haste > Versatility (both heroes)
notes: Same priority for Chronowarden and Scalecommander.
Do not neglect Intellect: substantial ilvl increases generally win.

enchants.chest: Enchant Chest - Mark of the Worldsoul

mplus.hero_note: Scalecommander is easier and less ally-reliant, so average players often do better with it in keys; Chronowarden has the higher ceiling.
tips: Prescience targets matter: pick the two strongest DPS and keep uptime near 100%.
Blistering Scales on the tank before every pull; re-apply after it drops.
Breath of Eons flight path planning is the skill check of the spec in keys.
